summary: Metric arithmetic and provided-toolkit GT mapping are correct; four actual scorer admission counterexamples prevent SOURCE acceptance.
scope: CPU-only metric, GT-source, and result-admission source review. No NN, torch model import, GPU query, SSH, training, original E0 progress query, benchmark prediction, or public metric CSV.

A_ground_truth_provenance.details: RGBT210/234 exports and manifests match all provided-toolkit float32 GT records and byte hashes; no GT is derived from predictions. LasHeR full test raw/rounded records match the provided toolkit. Remote original LasHeR dev/init provenance is supported by saved preparation code and terminal transport receipts, not a new remote inspection.

LasHeR.raw_manifest_initial_source: original LasHeR init.txt per recorded preparation; local toolkit scored rounded GT independently matched

B_score_normalization.details: No prediction-statistic score denominator. Frame fractions use fixed full sequence lengths; global curves use sequence macro means. NPR divides center coordinates by GT width/height (+1e-8), not prediction maxima/means. RGBT234 uses per-frame min center error / max IoU. Predictions are float32 rounded by original loader; dual GT is unrounded.

C_result_existence_and_origin.details: No actual new benchmark performance is claimed or established. Scorer artifact admission accepted four invalid CPU fixtures. Completion, prediction shape/finite values and many consistency checks work, but provenance is not sufficient for real benchmark acceptance.

D_called_metrics.details: Wrapper calls original PR/SR for RGBT210, MPR/MSR for RGBT234, and unchanged score_tracking.main for LasHeR PR/NPR/SR. Seven metrics and the real loader were exercised with independent arithmetic goldens.

E_scope.details: This is a CPU source/metric protocol review only. Full E0/E1 trained-checkpoint origin, native neural execution, real full benchmark predictions and dev-to-test frozen selection evidence are not established here. Saved preparation checked all names/counts and first/last image pairs only. The image interiors are not exhaustively decoded. Old BENCHMARK_DATA_STATUS.md and ISSUES.md still state the RGBT210 directory is missing although new private preparation names /data/wangwj/dataset/RGBT210testingset.

F_evaluation_type.details: Executed scores belong only to explicitly artificial private CPU protocol fixtures. They are not model performance, new baselines, tracking experiments, or evidence of target attainment.

frozen_test_origin.details: Scorer lines47-54 check declarative selection labels/counts/hash/configuration, but do not independently authenticate completed full-dev score artifacts or pre-test selection origin. No frozen selection files/results were supplied as completed experiment evidence. The separate NN SOURCE reviewer owns the full-C/selection-origin gate; a semantic source PASS here must not be interpreted as that gate passing.

issues.title: Unregistered and shortened manifest admitted by scorer
issues.observed: With the unchanged authoritative plan, the scorer accepted 97 artificial sequences / 291 frames under LasHeR dev and wrote scores, exit 0. The registered dev manifest has 54,646 frames and a different hash.
issues.cause: Supplied manifest is compared only with run config declarations. The scorer never binds it to plan.datasets, plan.input_sha256, or plan.split_sizes.
issues.required_fix: Bind manifest bytes, benchmark/split, counts, and full sequence coverage to the selected registered plan dataset before scoring.

issues.title: Borrowed native command admitted
issues.observed: Both config.native_command and native.command were set to ['python','OTHER_PROJECT_NOT_EXECUTED.py']; unchanged scorer accepted and wrote scores, exit 0. No such command was executed; the CPU test invoked only the scorer.
issues.cause: Native task/GPU/command are compared with mutable copied config fields; command executable/script and CLI bindings to run, task, variant, checkpoint, plan, benchmark, split, cost, candidate budget and shard are not reconstructed.
issues.required_fix: Validate the exact registered evaluation command and its arguments against each run/config, and the matching terminal native record. Do not accept a mutually consistent pair of unrelated command copies.

issues.title: Inconsistent parameter counts silently reported from first shard
issues.observed: Two shards declared total_parameters 123 and 987. The scorer accepted and reported only 123, exit 0.
issues.cause: total_parameters is absent from shard invariants while the first value is exported as a model property.
issues.required_fix: Require parameter-count agreement across all shards before reporting the shared model cost.

issues.title: Unregistered model variant admitted
issues.observed: All shards used variant='not_registered'. The dev scorer accepted it and exported that variant, exit 0.
issues.cause: The dev path requires only cross-shard equality. It never validates variant membership in registered models or binds model configuration to the recorded command.
issues.required_fix: Require a registered model variant and its variant-specific cost/candidate/checkpoint command binding before aggregation.

protocol_tests.fixture_correction: The first private metric fixture used Python lists where LasHeR expects NumPy row arrays and failed with TypeError before wrapper execution. test_protocol_r1.py and its separate fixture directory remain preserved. Only private fixture row types/directory were corrected for R2; all production hashes stayed equal. This is a reviewer fixture correction, not a project-source failure.

limits: Local byte hashes attest the listed source version only; they do not authenticate remote neural execution or execution-time model weights.
Original large checkpoint files and data/manifest.json were not present in the reviewed local project; private benchmark manifests were read from the supplied copied receipt bundle.
Remote image roots and preparation are evidenced by saved code/receipts; no new SSH was permitted or performed.

RGBT234 afterrain visible differs numerically between image-directory annotations and the provided toolkit; this review establishes deliberate toolkit-source use, not equality of those dataset versions.
Source protocol fixes and a fresh review are required before admitting real aggregate scores.
